title: Measurement and Traceability Quality Workbook
purpose: Provide controlled records for units and conversions, uncertainty, calibration, representative sampling, and permanent identifiers.

sections.title: Units and Conversion Record
qualityRules: Preserve the original value and unit.
State whether concentration or yield values are on wet, dry, area, volume, or mass basis.
Reject conversions that fail dimensional consistency.

sections.title: Accuracy, Precision, and Uncertainty Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Is the observed difference larger than the combined measurement variability and uncertainty relevant to the decision?

sections.title: Calibration and Verification Record
sections.decisionPrompt: If the instrument was out of tolerance as found, which previous measurements may require review?

sections.title: Representative Sampling Plan
qualityRules: Define the population before collecting samples.
Do not generalize beyond the sampled population and time window.
Record spatial, temporal, and biological sampling structure.

sections.title: Permanent Identifier and Relationship Record
qualityRules: Changing a display label must not destroy lineage or history.
Record corrections as corrections rather than silently overwriting prior identity.
Preserve original observations before conversion or correction.
Separate instrument capability from biological variability.
Make every measurement traceable to method, sample, instrument, time, and unit.
Keep identity history append-only wherever practical.
Do not promote draft records into release evidence without review.
